subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw keep the current native SwiftUI List direction for the iOS Control tab, or sponsor this flatter custom card layout after a rebase?
rationale: The PR is a visual product-direction change that now conflicts with merged native iOS design work, so automation cannot safely choose the default iOS Control tab direction.

options.title: Keep native List direction
options.body: Treat current main and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99231 as the preferred iOS direction and ask for a new narrow design proposal only if cards are still desired.

options.title: Sponsor card layout rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase over current main, preserve the native navigation improvements, convert text to OpenClawType, and attach before/after simulator proof.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close this PR and the paired feature issue if maintainers decide the card-based Control layout is no longer desired after the native redesign.

recommendation.title: Keep native List direction
recommendation.body: Treat current main and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99231 as the preferred iOS direction and ask for a new narrow design proposal only if cards are still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the most relevant merged Control/Talk visual hierarchy work and supplied the current design/proof context that overlaps this PR.
